notes.title: A Street Cat's Tale: NekoNeko Edition officially released on June 27th (Thu)!
notes.content:
Greetings! 

[b]A Street Cat's Tale: NekoNeko Edition[/b], a compilation package exclusively for the Nintendo Switch™ featuring [b]A Street Cat's Tale[/b], the original kitty adventure game telling of the lives of cats on the streets, and [b]A Street Cat's Tale 2: Outside is Dangerous[/b], the sequel telling the various tales of lost pet kitty Cinnamon's journey through the streets, was [b]released to the Nintendo Switch™ on June 27th (Thursday)![/b]

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/35648228/65c0cff8281b1528795080bae5d936813615c24d.jpg[/img]

Today, you can experience the heart-warming stories of cats, people, and the other animals you meet along the way!

[b]《A Street Cat's Tale: NekoNeko Edition》[/b]
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/35648228/8fa9439a347cd80227b9e5b3671cd6e88c4cf8ed.png[/img]
[i]※A Street Cat's Tale: NekoNeko Edition is a package exclusive to the Nintendo Switch™ console.
※You can find this package through various online and offline retailers.[/i]

In addition to this, a downloadable version of A Street Cat's Tale 2: Outside is Dangerous is [b]now available on the Nintendo Switch™[/b], allowing players to enjoy the entire A Street Cat's Tale series on the Nintendo Switch™.

• My Nintendo Store 「A Street Cat's Tale」
https://www.nintendo.com/us/store/products/a-street-cats-tale-switch/

• My Nintendo Store 「A Street Cat's Tale 2: Outside is Dangerous」
https://www.nintendo.com/us/store/products/a-street-cats-tale-2-outside-is-dangerous-switch/

(You can also find this game in your regional Nintendo eShop.)

As always, thank you for your support as we continue to work our hardest to bring you the best games.

Thank you.

notes.title: A Street Cat's Tale trading card has been released!
notes.content:
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/35648228/08b319636d81a7ff23c0476be07901bdb21f94b1.png[/img]
Trading cards for A Street Car's Tale is finally here!
The cards become available depending on your gameplay hours.
Don't forget to create badges for a profile background image and emoticons, too!

We will keep doing our best to meet your expectations.

notes.title: A Street Cat's Tale Patch Notes - 3/13/2020
notes.content:
Hello everyone, this is CFK.

Nintendo Switch version of A Street Cat's Tale was released on March 12 (Thu) 2020.
We updated the STEAM version to match the Nintendo Switch version.

The details of the update are as follows:
[list]
[*]Applied the new logo design
[*]Added keyboard and gamepad control options
[*]Added screen resolution change and full-screen mode options
[*]Miscellaneous improvements on in-game features and stability
[/list]
Thank you very much for purchasing A Street Cat's Tale,
and also for visiting the community hub with an interest in our game.

Our gratitude never stops. We will keep doing our best to meet your expectations.
